# ProgressBot.AI

> ProgressBot.AI builds AI phone agents for home service contractors (roofing,
> solar, HVAC, and similar trades) - a crew of seven agents that answer,
> cold-call, sell, confirm, and follow up with customers, 24/7, inbound and
> outbound.

ProgressBot.AI is not a general-purpose voice-AI platform: the agents are
purpose-built for the home-service call flow (missed calls, aged leads,
welcome calls after signing, milestone updates), sold and deployed per
contractor, staffed and maintained by ProgressBot.AI rather than self-serve
configured by the customer.

Core claims (verified, used consistently across the site):
- Answers 24/7 within 3 rings; no voicemail; routes and triages calls; books
  onto the calendar; hands off to a human when needed; texts call recaps;
  updates the CRM automatically.
- Typical results: live in 1-2 weeks; 70-90% less cost than human reps for the
  same phone work; ROI in 30-60 days; 3-5x more calls handled; 20-40%
  conversion.
- Compliance: TCPA, GDPR, CCPA; encrypted; audit trails; multilingual
  (including Spanish).
- Framing: one missed $10,000 job call, once a week, is worth $520k+/year in
  lost revenue.
- Solar-specific: NREL (2022) found 33% of residential solar sales cancel
  after the sale - this stat is used only on solar-related pages.
- Reported outcome (single customer, not a guarantee): Blake Ambrester, CEO of
  Solar Bear, reports that Frank's welcome calls cut cancellations by roughly
  20%.

Contact: (863) 354-1635 - https://progressbot.ai/
Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/XUoJuoe7KfdcS4S28

## Agents

- [Botty - live demo](https://progressbot.ai/botty): AI sales rep,
  hear it answer a real call live in about 30 seconds. Public demo runs the
  default roofing call flow.
- [Banx - the cold caller](https://progressbot.ai/banx): works fresh and aged
  leads, qualifies them, books appointments, texts the team.
- [Zoe - the receptionist](https://progressbot.ai/zoe): 24/7 inbound
  answering, routes calls, books appointments, human handoff.
- [Brenda - the web bot](https://progressbot.ai/brenda): answers website
  visitors in real time, collects lead info, books appointments.
- [Ava - the assistant](https://progressbot.ai/ava): answers your personal
  phone line 24/7, gives accurate info about you/your business, books into
  Google Calendar, texts a summary after the call.
- [Frank - the welcome bot](https://progressbot.ai/frank): calls every new
  customer minutes after signing, confirms the contract, catches rep
  promises that don't match paperwork, retries on voicemail.
- [Ula - the updater](https://progressbot.ai/ula): weekly and milestone
  update calls to customers already in the pipeline, flags at-risk accounts,
  integrates with CRM/quoting/calendar/dialers/financing.
